4. CUSTOMER ADVANCE / REVENUE CLASSIFICATION
============================================================

Customer Orion placed an order for ₹2.4 crore.

The customer paid ₹1.2 crore on 29 March.

The goods were not manufactured until April.

Management recorded ₹1.2 crore as revenue in March because
"the customer order was confirmed."

The customer agreement describes the ₹1.2 crore as a non-refundable
advance against future deliveries.

No revenue was recognized against the remaining ₹1.2 crore.

The goods were delivered on 30 March.

On 2 April the customer complained that approximately 15% of the goods
were defective.

On 12 April the customer returned ₹9.8 lakh of goods.

Management says the return was caused by a production defect.

No provision or adjustment had been recorded at 31 March.
